__: The version of each PRODUCT in this repository, and the only place it is decided. Every other spelling -- config.h, module.json, each engine's crates -- is checked against this by `ctest -R versions`. See tests/versions.test.mjs for what is checked and what is deliberately not.
__audio-bus: The house transport, not a plugin -- it has crates and no config.h, no plists and no bundle. It is versioned here anyway because it is a thing that SHIPS INSIDE two products, and a crate whose version nothing checks is a crate that will disagree with itself.
